mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.merchant_category_id, c.name, p.policy FROM T_MCC_POLICY_M p JOIN T_MCC_CTGR_C c ON p.merchant_category_id = c.id WHERE p.id = #{id}
SELECT p.id, p.merchant_category_id, c.name, p.policy FROM T_MCC_POLICY_M p JOIN T_MCC_CTGR_C c ON p.merchant_category_id = c.id WHERE p.child_id = #{childId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_MCC_POLICY_M (parent_id, child_id, merchant_category_id, policy, created_at) SELECT #{parentId}, #{childId}, c.id, c.default_policy, NOW() FROM T_MCC_CTGR_C c
mapper.select: SELECT c.id FROM T_MCC_CODE_C m JOIN T_MCC_CTGR_C c ON m.merchant_category_id = c.id WHERE m.id = #{merchantCode}

SELECT p.id, p.merchant_category_id, c.name, p.policy FROM T_MCC_POLICY_M p JOIN T_MCC_CTGR_C c ON p.merchant_category_id = c.id WHERE p.merchant_category_id = #{categoryId} AND p.child_id = #{childId}
